bugs.error_message: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'join') in frappe.get_route_str
bugs.root_cause: v16 frappe.get_route_str() is `frappe.router.current_route.join('/')`; current_route is null until the first route resolves, so calling it at boot throws.
bugs.fix: Guard with `if (!frappe.router.current_route) return;` before calling get_route_str(); same guard added to sidebar_v2.js currentRoutePath().

bugs.error_message: list_v2 card grid never rendered on list views
bugs.root_cause: Code listened for a `list_view_render` jQuery event that Frappe v16 does not fire (the plan's selector pre-check wrongly assumed it existed).
bugs.fix: Replaced the event listener with a monkey-patch of frappe.views.ListView.prototype.after_render, which base_list.js calls right after render() populates rows and `this.data`.

bugs.error_message: 417 EXPECTATION FAILED: SQL functions are not allowed as strings in SELECT; Invalid field format in Group By: 1=1
bugs.root_cause: v16 frappe.db.get_list rejects string SQL functions in `fields` ('sum(outstanding_amount) as total') and rejects the `group_by: '1=1'` collapse trick.
bugs.fix: Use dict aggregate syntax `fields: [{ SUM: 'outstanding_amount', as: 'total' }]` and drop group_by (a bare SUM already returns one total row).

bugs.error_message: Card styling (Tier-6 flat card identity) not appearing on talimsahl site after app update
bugs.root_cause: Two-layer stale cache problem after hooks.py changed app_include_css. (1) Redis app_hooks key ({db_name}|app_hooks) held the old pickled hooks — 'bench clear-cache' does NOT flush this key. (2) Running gunicorn workers held the old hooks.py Python module in memory; when Redis was cleared they raced to re-populate it with the old in-memory value before the fresh value could be written. The CSS file itself also has Cache-Control: max-age=31536000 with no content hash in the filename, so browsers cache it for a year.
bugs.fix: 1. Restart workers: sudo supervisorctl restart frappe-bench-16-web:* — forces reload of hooks.py from disk. 2. Delete stale Redis key: redis-cli -p 13002 DEL '{db_name}|app_hooks' (db_name found in sites/SITE/site_config.json). 3. Added ?v=YYYYMMDD query string to CSS paths in app_include_css in hooks.py — busts browser 1-year cache on next deploy without needing a filename hash.

bugs.error_message: List view switcher duplicates ts-list-toolbar on every click and toggling does nothing
bugs.root_cause: Idempotency guard in renderViewSwitcher searched inside listview.$frappe_list (.frappe-list), but .before() inserted the new toolbar as a SIBLING of .frappe-list under listview.page.main. Guard never saw its own output, so every re-render stacked another .ts-list-toolbar. Mode click handler only persisted to localStorage and called listview.refresh() — no visible transition, no cleanup of .ts-card-row markup.
bugs.fix: Anchored both guard-check and insertion to $(listview.page.main). When toolbar exists, refresh chips + call updateActiveButton() helper instead of re-injecting. Click handler now calls decorate(listview) synchronously for instant feedback before async refresh. decorate() strips .ts-list-card children and .ts-card-row class when leaving cards mode. Kanban-not-found branch calls updateActiveButton($page, "cards") to revert the active pill.

FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/home/frappe/frappe-bench-16/erp.local/logs/database.log' when running a standalone frappe.init() script outside bench
bugs.root_cause: Frappe's logger (frappe/utils/logger.py create_handler) builds log paths relative to CWD ('site/logs/...', '../logs/...') instead of from frappe.local.site_path. The `bench` CLI always chdir's into sites/ before running any command, which is the implicit contract this relies on; a script invoked from the bench root has the wrong CWD and the relative path resolves to a nonexistent directory.
bugs.fix: Added os.chdir(sites_path) before frappe.init() in gen_sid.py, and changed frappe.init(sites_path=sites_path) to frappe.init(sites_path=".") to match.

bugs.error_message: Form hero eyebrow label glued directly to the document title with no space, worst on mobile/RTL (e.g. 'STUDENTرحمن محمد'); on desktop it looked like a stray '@' next to 'STUDENT' (actually the home-breadcrumb icon with no gap)
bugs.root_cause: form_hero.js prepends .ts-form-hero as the first child of Frappe's .title-area, which is a zero-gap flex row (page.html: `<div class="flex title-area ellipsis">`) shared with the breadcrumb <ul>. On mobile the breadcrumb collapses to just the final segment, removing the '/' separators that were masking the missing gap on desktop.
bugs.fix: Added margin-inline-end: 12px and flex-shrink: 0 to .ts-form-hero in desk-overrides.css — guarantees a gap after the hero block regardless of what Frappe renders next in the row. Did not relocate the JS injection point (keeps the project's 'style via CSS, never restructure Frappe's DOM' discipline).
